sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Co-immunoprecipitation with VEGFR-2 was demonstrated, confirming expression and interaction competence of the tagged full-length protein; surface localization was not explicitly assayed.
sites.rationale: DCBLD2 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein whose signal peptide spans residues 1–66 (computed landmarks); the mature extracellular domain begins at residue 67 and is the sole extracellular terminus. An N-terminal FLAG tag on the full-length construct must reside after the signal-peptide cleavage site (residue 66/67 junction) to be present on the mature protein surface; placing it upstream would result in co-cleavage with the signal peptide. Python verification confirms residue 66 = A and residue 67 = Q, consistent with the sequence. Position is topology-derived because the paper names no residue. Custom full-length DCBLD2 construct (pCDNA3-Flag-DCBLD2-HA, generated by Quintara Bio) bearing an N-terminal FLAG tag was expressed in cells and used for co-immunoprecipitation studies of DCBLD2 interactions with VEGFR-2. No residue number is stated for the tag junction.

sources.claim: The pCDNA3.4-CD45AP-HA (C terminal), pCDNA3.4-BRICD5-HA (C terminal), and pCDNA3-Flag-DCBLD2-HA (N terminal Flag, C terminal -HA) plasmids were generated by Quintara Bio.

literature_notes: L1–L4 all reference the same OriGene commercial plasmid (RC224483) with C-terminal Myc/Flag tags; these are disqualified because the tag position is unstated for a commercial plasmid and cannot be pinned to a residue. Even if the position were derivable (C-terminus = residue 775), that terminus lies in the intracellular domain (553–775) and would not qualify as a surface site. They are recorded in other_positions. L6 describes domain-fragment constructs (not full-length membrane-anchored protein) with C-terminal HA tags and is disqualified on that basis. L5 yields one surface site (N-terminal FLAG, topology_derived) and one intracellular tag (C-terminal HA, other_positions).

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA tag on the same full-length pCDNA3-Flag-DCBLD2-HA construct; the C-terminus (residue 775) lies in the intracellular domain (553–775) and faces the cytoplasm.
